summary: Honeywell International Inc. filed an 8-K announcing board approval and declaration of the distribution for the spin-off of its Aerospace Technologies business into an independent publicly traded company (Honeywell Aerospace Inc.). Concurrently, four directors (Craig Arnold, William Ayer, D. Scott Davis, Deborah Flint) will resign from Honeywell's board effective immediately before the spin-off, as they are expected to join the spun-off entity's board; another director, Jillian Evanko, resigned immediately due to other commitments. No disagreements were cited. The filing also notes a press release on June 15, 2026 with further details. Watch for the distribution record date, tax opinion, and any potential regulatory or shareholder challenges. The risk-arb angle centers on the separation mechanics and relative value of the two post-spin equities.
